lines: Meiya: Shirogane. That name was never sworn to your keeping.
Meiya: You gave it away once. It does not return because you ask.
Meiya: Formal complaint filed. Informally: I believe you can fix this.
Meiya: Name your owners. Honor your loans. Return alive.
Meiya: Disappointed, yes. Surprised, no. Fix it anyway.
speaker: MEIYA
